reviewMethod: Read-only inspection of the installed source, governing contract and actual regression bodies; independent byte audit of the parent-executed owner admission receipt. Reviewer did not duplicate Cargo execution.

reviewObservations.observation: Caller transformed output lookup, domain and normalized-literal failures map to WFT-SECURITY-LOWERING-UNSUPPORTED. Initial require_sources diagnostic propagation is unchanged.

A valid source-admitted transformed declaration passes first; wrong literal type changes only the literal, while unknown element and existing Record cases change both output reference and declared model domain to reach lookup/domain checks. All require the exact lowering diagnostic.

255 distinct transforms plus conservative Original pass at 256. A source requiring 256 transforms plus Original refuses a backend declaration truncated to 256; source coverage is not inferred from caller cardinality.

COUNT alone and after a valid grouped Field refuse the complete checker. These natural aggregate declarations exercise complete refusal, not independently isolated expression-discriminator branch coverage.

Both source and caller literal normalization charge normalized retained payload before class retention/comparison. Regression uses actual exponent expansion and exact BigInt magnitude-word accounting.

Original requires resolved required presence; optional Original and Absent refuse. Normalized equivalent literals retain every scoped source ID; unequal classes remain required even alongside Withheld.

API returns Result<()> for pure declaration correspondence. CONTRACT-005 preserves runtime composition, result-cell validation, aggregate semantics, physical/capability coverage and native admission as separate requirements; compile.rs still unconditionally refuses lowering after registration.

scope: Selected pure owner-bound direct-field declaration correspondence and diagnostic contract only. This review is not a code-refinement theorem, runtime outcome selection, executable lowering, result codec or native/backend acceptance qualification.
